preconditions.description: Attacker must have some TST token balance to initiate the attack
Contract must be in unrestricted state (unrestricted == true)

exploit_hint: The approve() function has a race condition vulnerability due to the requirement 'allowed[msg.sender][_spender] == 0 || _value == 0'. Attack by: 1) First approve a spender with non-zero amount, 2) While that approval is pending, send another approve transaction with zero amount, 3) The spender can front-run and transfer tokens using the first approval before it's set to zero, then the second approval sets allowance to zero, allowing the spender to double-spend the same allowance.
